title: tf-blast Configuration Policy
description: Configuration schema for tf-blast policy rules, severity classifications, and blast-radius gates.

rules.description: Custom risk classification patterns mapped to severity levels

critical.description: Resource type patterns considered CRITICAL risk (e.g. databases, object storage)

high.description: Resource type patterns considered HIGH risk (e.g. security groups, routing, IAM)

medium.description: Resource type patterns considered MEDIUM risk (e.g. compute instances, load balancers)

low.description: Resource type patterns considered LOW risk (e.g. DNS records, tags, alarms)

fail_on.description: Failure threshold that triggers exit code 1 for CI policy enforcement

max_blast.description: Maximum acceptable total blast radius count before failing the policy check (0 disables threshold)

max_score.description: Maximum acceptable weighted blast score before failing the policy check (0 disables threshold)

ignore_resources.description: List of resource address or type patterns to exclude from blast radius calculations
